name: 咖色迷彩工装雪裤
description: 咖啡色系迷彩阔腿雪裤：松紧腰配抽绳，前后和两侧都是带金属按扣的工装大口袋，裤脚可以抽绳收紧。很好搭，配纯色上衣就很酷。尺码 S。
descriptionEn: Wide-leg snow pants in a brown camo print, with an elastic drawstring waist, snap-button cargo pockets front, back and on the sides, and drawcord cuffs. Easy to style — pair them with a solid top for an effortlessly cool look. Size S.
